name: Blood Runs Dry
source:
One year ago, the queen died.  A violent tyrant to her people, the kingdom held their breath that her son, the sole heir, would be a better ruler.

One year ago, Eleanor left home, taking up work as a royal servant. She hoped someone new on the throne meant a new start for herself, and a new start for the kingdom.

But nothing was different. 

Now the coronation of the prince approaches. As one of the greener servants, Eleanor isn't expecting to be to involved in the festivities. But soon she'll end up getting closer to the prince than she expected.

The smell of blood hangs from him...

But is there more to him than meets the eye?

[From [url=https://ceelibeans.itch.io/blood-runs-dry]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一年前，女王去世了。作为人民的残暴暴君，王国屏息以待她的儿子，唯一的继承人，会成为一个更好的统治者。

一年前，埃莉诺离开家，开始担任皇家仆人。她希望新的王位登上王位，这对她自己来说是一个新的开始，对整个王国来说也是一个新的开始。

但一切都没有什么不同。

现在王子的加冕典礼临近了。作为环保仆人之一，埃莉诺并不期望参与庆祝活动。但很快她就​​会与王子变得比她预想的更亲近。

他的身上，弥漫着血腥味……

但他还有比表面上看到的更多的东西吗？
